CHAPTER IX.
The Mock Turtle's Story


The Duchess, now oddly affectionate, walked with Alice, finding a
strained moral in everything said, until the Queen arrived and sent
the Duchess away. Alice was then taken by the Queen to meet the
Gryphon, who led her to the sorrowful Mock Turtle.

The Mock Turtle described his old school under the sea, where
lessons included "Reeling and Writhing," Ambition, Distraction,
Uglification, and Derision, taught for fewer hours each day since
lessons "lessen" from day to day.
